{{Top|leg}}
A '''static ion field discharger''' was an ion-based weapon in use by the [[Exocron Airfleet]]. When fired, the weapon produced an ion charge that hit all targets within a given range. It was especially useful against [[skyfighter]]s and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
